name: opa-policy-gate
description: Reference Open Policy Agent policy gate that preserves OPA UX while adding Ouroboros audit, provenance, and handoff semantics.

commands.name: eval
commands.summary: Evaluate a bounded OPA Rego query and attach decision evidence.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Repo-relative JSON config describing query, policies, data, input, bundle, and safe eval flags.

commands.name: test
commands.summary: Run bounded OPA Rego tests and attach validation evidence.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Repo-relative JSON config describing policy/test files, data, and safe test flags.

commands.name: check
commands.summary: Run bounded OPA static checks before policy execution.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Repo-relative JSON config describing Rego, schema, and capability files for static checking.

commands.name: build-handoff
commands.summary: Build a bounded OPA bundle and AgentOS handoff artifact.

arguments.name: config
arguments.description: Repo-relative JSON config describing bundle sources and optional output name.

capabilities.name: ledger
capabilities.reason: Record policy gate invocation, normalized decision status, and validation outcomes.

capabilities.name: provenance
capabilities.reason: Record OPA version, command, query, input hashes, policy paths, and result artifact paths.

capabilities.name: state
capabilities.reason: Persist policy gate state and resumable handoff metadata between invocations.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.reason: Attach OPA decisions and validation evidence to downstream Ouroboros execution.

capabilities.name: progress
capabilities.reason: Report completed, failed, and blocked policy gate states.

permissions.reason: Read repo-relative Rego, data, input, bundle, schema, and config files.
Invoke the installed OPA CLI with bounded arguments and no arbitrary passthrough.
Write bounded raw-result, normalized-result, provenance, and handoff artifacts under .omx/artifacts/opa/.
